correctness.rationale: The class is exactly closed radius-one balls B_C={Q three-set:|Q∩C|>=2}; not open adjacency. For a hypothetical five-shattered support, every query pair needs >=2^3=8 centers positive on both; distinct triples intersecting in <=1 symbol have <=4 such centers, hence any five must pairwise meet in two. Five such triples share a fixed pair, but a center then realizes either all five positives or at most two, impossible to realize a 3-positive label. For four-supports, at most twelve used ground labels plus at most three extra in any center stabilizes all traces at n=15. The inspected check.py canonically enumerates four-triple incidence types using first-occurrence labels, quotients by all 24 query permutations via 15 nonzero incidence masks, and checks all 455 centers at n=15. Independently rebuilt type generator: [7,151,6328] rooted progression, exactly 66 unrooted types and exactly one 16-trace shattered orbit, with explicit seven-symbol witness. Independent global all-support enumeration for n=5,6,7 found (10,30,0,0), (20,180,960,0), (35,525,4340,630) shattered counts for k=1..4, corroborating boundary dimensions. Unique common v plus two repeated partners and four leaves gives n*C(n−1,2)*C(n−3,2)*C(n−5,2) without overcounting. All-n claim rests on exhaustive finite type lemma plus stabilization proof, not just n<=7 data.
